9 isolated independent schema tests passed: omission/null behavior; complete HEX roundtrip and field order; all required nested fields; numeric widths and signedness; exact two-element tuple shape; existing HSE compatibility and coexistence; pin omission compatibility; structural-versus-physical validation boundary; actual static generation shape.

The exact four generator clock-model definitions and the existing Debug/stringify function were extracted without semantic edits. Generated legacy, HSE-only, HEX-only, and combined records compiled against the exact four static metadata definitions and their value assertions ran successfully.

compatibility.wire_backward_compatibility: ClockLimits.hex uses serde(default, skip_serializing_if = Option::is_none): absent and explicit null become None and serialize without hex. Generator PeripheralClockLimits.hex defaults to None for absence/null. Static PAC model stores Option<PeripheralHexLimits>.
compatibility.nested_required_fields: When hex is present, all six HEX fields are required and non-null. Its input requires minimum_hz, maximum_hz, supply_mv, and temperature_c. No nested default synthesizes electrical facts.
compatibility.numeric_types: HEX input frequency is u32, supply range is (u16,u16), temperature range is signed (i16,i16), duty and high/low VDDIO percentage ranges are (u8,u8), and timing limits are u16. All three models agree; no narrowing conversion or new numeric enum was introduced.
compatibility.tuple_shape: All five nested or direct HEX ranges are exact two-element tuples. JSON arrays with zero, one, or three elements fail in both deserializing models.
compatibility.existing_hse: ExternalClockLimits and HseLimits definitions are byte-preserved. HSE-only records roundtrip unchanged, HEX may coexist with HSE structurally, u64 CCS values remain intact, and the exact four-element HSE arrays retain their existing length constraints.
compatibility.static_generation: Existing derived Debug plus stringify produces nested PeripheralHexLimits and PeripheralExternalClockLimits struct expressions with ordinary tuples and Some/None. HSE static arrays still receive the existing borrow transformation. Emitted expressions compiled and ran against the static metadata model.
compatibility.pins: No pin record changed. Existing peripheral::Pin accepts the HEX signal with af/adc_mux/comparator_mux absent and omits those absent options when serializing.
compatibility.rust_source_break: Adding the public hex field requires downstream direct ClockLimits/PeripheralClockLimits struct literals to supply hex. Backward-compatible JSON does not imply Rust source compatibility.
compatibility.validation_boundary: These schemas enforce field presence, widths, signedness, and tuple length. They intentionally do not enforce interval ordering, percentages <=100, mutual exclusion of HSE/HEX, source provenance, or physical admissibility; those are separate generator/hardware-review responsibilities.
